rawFindings.title: Incorrect global replacement of '%' placeholder in hook function
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces a global regular expression replacement for '%' with a single string replacement. The original code replaced all '%' characters globally, but the new code replaces only the first occurrence. This change could cause problems if the script command string contains multiple '%' placeholders, as only one will be replaced with the ordered package names instead of all.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the replacement back to using a global regex to replace all '%' characters: use new RegExp('%', 'g') as the first argument to mout.string.replace.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If config.scripts[action] contains more than one '%' character, only the first '%' is replaced with the package list, resulting in incorrect command strings being run and possibly failing scripts.
